description: Enables inline database blocks in TmNotionEditor. Provides field definitions, view configuration, paginated record queries (with filter, sort, grouping), record CRUD, sub-items, templates, and CSV import/export. The database block is hidden from the slash menu when this provider is not supplied.

methods.name: GetFieldsAsync
methods.description: Returns all field (column) definitions for the database.

methods.name: CreateFieldAsync
methods.description: Adds a new field to the database schema.

methods.name: UpdateFieldAsync
methods.description: Updates a field definition (rename, type change).

methods.name: DeleteFieldAsync
methods.description: Removes a field from the database schema.

methods.name: ReorderFieldsAsync
methods.description: Persists the new field column order.

methods.name: GetViewsAsync
methods.description: Returns all saved views (Table, Board, List, Gallery, Calendar, Timeline).

methods.name: CreateViewAsync
methods.description: Creates a new database view.

methods.name: UpdateViewAsync
methods.description: Persists view configuration changes (filter, sort, grouping, visible fields).

methods.name: DeleteViewAsync
methods.description: Deletes a view.

methods.name: DuplicateViewAsync
methods.description: Creates a copy of a view with all its settings.

methods.name: GetRecordsAsync
methods.description: Returns a paginated, filtered, sorted, and grouped set of records.

parameters.name: filter
parameters.description: Active filter conditions, or null for no filter.

parameters.name: sorts
parameters.description: Sort specifications, or null for default order.

parameters.name: grouping
parameters.description: Grouping field and direction, or null for no grouping.

methods.name: GetRecordAsync
methods.description: Loads a single record by ID (for the record detail modal).

methods.name: CreateRecordAsync
methods.description: Creates a new record.

methods.name: UpdateRecordAsync
methods.description: Updates field values for an existing record.

methods.name: DeleteRecordAsync
methods.description: Deletes a record.

methods.name: BatchUpdateRecordsAsync
methods.description: Updates multiple records in a single call (e.g. bulk status change).

methods.name: GetSubItemsAsync
methods.description: Returns sub-items (child records) of a parent record.

methods.name: MoveRecordAsync
methods.description: Moves a record to a different parent (for hierarchical databases).

parameters.name: newParentRecordId
parameters.description: New parent ID, or null for root.

methods.name: GetTemplatesAsync
methods.description: Returns available record templates for quick row creation.

methods.name: CreateTemplateAsync
methods.description: Creates a new record template.

methods.name: UpdateTemplateAsync
methods.description: Updates an existing record template.

methods.name: DeleteTemplateAsync
methods.description: Deletes a record template.

methods.name: CreateRecordFromTemplateAsync
methods.description: Creates a new record pre-populated with a template's default field values.

methods.name: ImportCsvAsync
methods.description: Imports records from a CSV stream. Header row maps to field names.

methods.name: ExportCsvAsync
methods.description: Exports records to a CSV stream, optionally applying a view's current filter.

parameters.name: viewId
parameters.description: View ID whose filter/sort to apply, or null for all records.
